title: Welcome to their party! @New York City Center  📸 Jenny Anderson #broa...
transcript: The people have been demanding: what about LaChiusa’s Wild Party? Well, now you have a rare opportunity to see it, and you could not ask for a better cast. And the lore here is almost as fascinating as the musical itself: So for those who don't remember, back in 2000, there were famously two different musical versions of the Wild Party playing in New York at basically the same time. Both based on the 1928 narrative poem of the same name. One was written by Andrew Lippa, while the other one was written by Michael John LaChiusa and George C. Wolfe Lippa's version tends to be more well known nowadays, but many die-hard musical theater fans will swear by the LaChiusa/Wolfe version. And that's the version that Encores is about to do for two weeks only with this insanely stacked cast, we got Tony-winner Adrienne Warren, Jasmine Amy Rogers , Jelani Alladin, Jordan Donica, Lesli Margherita And maybe most exciting of all, we have Tony-winning legend Tonya Pinkins, who was in the original cast of this musical, returning in a new role. And the musical itself has this energy to it that's dark and chaotic but also kind of sexy in a twisted sort of way. Using this propulsive 1920s jazz style to lure us into the world of these messy, depraved people. Meanwhile, the book is cleverly written in this 5-act vaudeville structure which feels like setting up dominoes that all come tumbling down, making it truly feel like this wild party gone wrong. So if you have the opportunity to see this concert revival at New York City Center of this seldom-performed cult favorite, it's running March 18-29 only, and I really don't think it's one to miss.
